summary: Frontend-only E2E test of F4 Front Desk Check-in (early check-in fee + approval, and the two non-ready blocker cases) on the public preview URL as admin@stayos.local. (1) HS260818-01009 (3de9c47f..., Karan Gill, Deluxe 201, arriving today, server clock 03:01 => before 14:00): Step 4 'Room readiness' renders data-testid="early-checkin-notice" with 'Early arrival - before standard check-in 14:00', data-testid="early-checkin-fee" = '₹1,000' (contains '1,000'), and data-testid="early-checkin-approve" checkbox labelled 'Approve early check-in fee (₹1,000)'. Ticking the box and clicking the footer CTA (data-testid="checkin-complete", label 'Check in Karan Gill to Room 201') fired the check-in successfully: green toast 'Check-in complete / Karan Gill is now in Room 201. Opening the stay workspace.' and the app navigated to /guest-stay/3de9c47f-de1b-4326-8e84-c45aaeaa1557. On the stay page the badge shows CHECKED IN, Room 201 - Deluxe, and the folio FO260818-00175 now contains the line 'Early check-in charge  1  ₹1,000.00' - so the fee is posted ONLY after explicit approval, as designed. (2) HS260818-01010 (aa25b7a7..., no room): Step 4 shows 'No room assigned' + an 'Assign a room' button linking to /reservations/aa25b7a7-4622-4b1b-8f93-c48ed594c214; there is NO checkin-complete button (count 0) - the footer CTA re-labels to data-testid="checkin-open-rooms" ('Open rooms board'), so check-in cannot be completed. (3) HS260818-01011 (06a78b09..., Deluxe 203 NEEDS_CLEANING): Step 4 shows 'Room 203 - Deluxe - Status: NEEDS_CLEANING' + orange warning 'Room is NEEDS_CLEANING' + 'Open rooms board' link; checkin-complete count 0, footer CTA = checkin-open-rooms and clicking it navigated to /rooms?mode=assign&status=ready&reservationId=06a78b09-... (no check-in performed). No 4xx/5xx API responses and no raw HTTP status text appeared in any flow. All 3 requested scenarios PASS functionally; 4 cosmetic/UX issues found (raw enum text NEEDS_CLEANING shown to staff, early-fee notice+approval rendered even when the room is not assignable/not ready, footer guidance says 'Open rooms board' for an unassigned room, and the Mantine loading state on Complete could not be observed).

ui_bugs.issue: Raw enum code leaked to the user: header reads 'Status: NEEDS_CLEANING' and the warning reads 'Room is NEEDS_CLEANING' instead of human copy like 'Room 203 needs cleaning - housekeeping has not released it yet'. Violates the 'no ALL_CAPS codes' requirement (room.operationalStatus is printed verbatim; 'Status: N/A' / 'Room Unassigned - - -' for the unassigned case is also raw/awkward).

The early-check-in notice, fee and approval checkbox render even when the room is UNASSIGNED (01010) or NEEDS_CLEANING (01011), where check-in cannot be completed. Staff can tick an approval that does nothing. Gate the notice on canCheckInSoft or make it read-only until the room is ready.

For the unassigned reservation the footer title/detail are 'Room must be ready before check-in' / 'Open the rooms board if the room needs assignment or readiness work.' and the CTA is 'Open rooms board'. For a booking with NO room the next action should be 'Assign a room' (deep-link to the booking/rooms-assign view) rather than generic readiness wording.

Could not observe the Mantine loading state: 600ms after clicking data-testid="checkin-complete" no loader / data-loading was present (the POST resolved very fast). Code binds loading={footerActionLoading} with isSubmitting==='complete', so double-click protection is likely present but is NOT verified by test. Recommend also disabling the button while submitting.

Missing data-testids on step-nav buttons and on the 'Assign a room' / 'Open rooms board' in-step links; step description and status badge text is clipped in the 260px sidebar ('ID photos, ID number and face sn...', badge shows 'NEEDE'). Add data-testid="checkin-step-{key}" / "checkin-assign-room" and allow text wrap.

issues: Raw uppercase enum in the room status line reads like a developer string

action_items: MEDIUM: humanize room operational status in Step 4 (map NEEDS_CLEANING/OUT_OF_ORDER/etc. to sentences) and replace 'Status: N/A' / 'Room Unassigned - - -' with readable copy.
LOW: hide (or make informational-only) the early-check-in fee approval checkbox when the room is unassigned or not ready.
LOW: when no room is assigned, change footer title/detail/CTA to an 'Assign a room' action instead of 'Open rooms board'.
LOW: add disabled={isSubmitting} alongside loading on checkin-complete and add data-testids to step-nav buttons and the assign/open-rooms links; fix sidebar text truncation.
critical_code_review_comments: CheckInWorkspacePage.tsx is ~2162 lines - far above the 700-line guideline; split per-step cards (identity/guest/payment/room), the footer and the notice components into separate files.

Room status is rendered as `{room.operationalStatus}` directly in JSX (lines ~1991 and in room.warnings), which is why the raw enum reaches the user; introduce a single formatter used by both the header line and the warning list.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 3 requested scenarios pass functionally; 5 cosmetic/UX defects logged

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. State change caused by testing (expected): reservation 3de9c47f-de1b-4326-8e84-c45aaeaa1557 (HS260818-01009) is now CHECKED_IN in Room 201 with an approved 'Early check-in charge' of ₹1,000.00 on folio FO260818-00175. HS260818-01010 and HS260818-01011 unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL + admin login work; first page load under `next dev` may HMR-reload, so wait ~4s and retry the login fill (loop used here). Wizard step-nav buttons have no data-testid - click page.locator('[data-testid="checkin-wizard-nav"]').get_by_role('button').filter(has_text='Room') to reach Step 4, then assert on [data-checkin-step="room"]. HS260818-01009 is already CHECKED_IN now, so re-testing the early-check-in happy path needs a fresh CONFIRMED arrival for today with a READY room. Remaining blocker fixtures still usable: aa25b7a7-4622-4b1b-8f93-c48ed594c214 (unassigned), 06a78b09-68c9-4fa1-8da5-6baa73653f9a (room 203 NEEDS_CLEANING). To verify the Complete button loading state, add a page.route delay on the check-in POST.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect. The only real leak is presentational: Step 4 prints reservation room.operationalStatus (and warning strings built from it) verbatim, so the DB enum NEEDS_CLEANING is shown to front-desk staff; a status->sentence mapper in the component fixes it.
